name: moo-workspace
description: Build tooling for Moo: the tish compiler and Lattish come from npm (see docs/building.md).

scripts.build: TISH="$PWD/node_modules/.bin/tish" bash plugins/build.sh && TISH_FAST_NATIVE_BUILD=1 bash app/build.sh
scripts.build:web: npm --prefix web ci && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.clean: rm -rf app/dist plugins/dist web/dist dist target packages/moo-macos/target app/node_modules plugins/node_modules
